profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procore Technologies
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software engineer with experience across multiple different work environments including the government, big enterprise and start ups. Some of the places I worked at include the Navy Yard (NAVSEA), Comcast, TruckBux,  Life Cycle Engineering and StructionSite/DroneDeploy. 

I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Drexel University in 2022, completing the university’s renowned 5-year co-op program. This blend of academic training and real-world experience has given me a huge advantage in the work place as I believe experience is highly important in becoming proficient as a software engineer, which is why I always tried to pick up either a side project or a part time job while I was in school. 

I'm passionate about building tools and applications that improve efficiency, boost productivity, and help users save time and resources. I enjoy identifying opportunities to optimize systems—whether through cost reduction, faster workflows, or smarter design. Throughout my career, I've collaborated closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and product managers to bring new products to life. I've also led and owned multiple features end-to-end, from initial design and architecture through implementation and delivery.

Outside of my career, I enjoy many hobbies including video games, reading, Muay Thai, rock climbing, basketball, and pickleball!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Angular · Front-End Development · AngularJS · Python (Programming Language) · MongoDB · HTML · SQL · React.js

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: My responsibilities included working with product owners, designers and other engineers to create new features that utilized simple and intuitive user interfaces. My work also involved integrated new APIs from other companies into our existing web application to offer customers new services. My daily tech stack included React, JS, HTML, CSS and Ruby/Ruby On Rails.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Ruby on Rails · Ruby

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: My responsibilities included creating new features for the NinjaMelk e-commerce website using Liquid.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: My responsibilities included developing an admin panel for internal use with React, JS, Java and Spring Boot, creating new features and fixing bugs in our TruckBux user app using Objective-C and Swift, and collaborating across different disciplines (designers and backend engineers), which included stand ups, grooming sessions and sprint reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My projects included refactoring existing internal websites to Angular, TypeScript with a C#/.NET backend, developing features for internal websites with HTML/CSS/JS and PHP, and administrating internal database systems with SQL Operations Studio.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Angular · JavaScript · C#

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: I worked at Comcast for my first co-op internship from Drexel's co-op program. Some of my responsibilities included developing new UI features for the Xfinity Mobile customer facing website using Angular and TypeScript, investigating and fixing bugs, developing user stories, and code reviews. I collaborated across many different specialties including the backend, design, and quality assurance.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · SQL

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: My responsibilities included refactoring and developing features for a behavioral tracking app used for local Philadelphia grade schools, investigating and fixing bugs with the iOS app, and managing the database through SQL Pro and MYSQL.
positions.insights: Skills: iOS · Swift (Programming Language) · Sequel Pro · SQL · Xcode

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: My responsibilities included recreating an emergency disaster navigation simulator, which was eventually sent to a Navy SWOS training school. This included a lot of manual connecting and creation of amphenol cables, splicing wires, installing software and testing that software. We also presented our projects at the end of the internship.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: My responsibilities included developing small features in C# and pair programming with senior engineers to learn the basics of being a software engineer.
